title: Coulter Model A counters placed, 1957 to 1961
description: Bar chart of Coulter Model A blood cell counters placed in laboratories, from the company's advertisements and records as tabulated by Graham (2020): 20 by June 1957, more than 150 by December 1958, more than 700 by January 1960 and more than 1,500 by February 1961.
heading: COULTER MODEL A COUNTERS PLACED
